reviews.comment: She was really great at explaining media history and how it applies to what's happening now. We had great discussions of current events at the beginning of most classes, which was my favorite part. Exams covered lectures, reading and viewing and were graded fairly. I subscribe to newspapers and magazines now--Thanks, Prof. Rubin!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: After taking JOUR102 (mass media history), 200 (journalism methods) and 304 (media editing) wth Prof. Rubin, I found she had strong views about media but was also open-minded about students' perspectives; was demanding in her expectations of students but also kind and helpful; and wise in her approach but never condescending. She was my TAMU fav.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Inspirational

reviews.comment: She is the worst teacher I've taken so far. She marks you down a whole letter grade for trivial things, her A boundary is a 91 instead of a 90, she rigs her grade distribution, and she actively fights her students when they answer her questions during exam review. Not helpful or understanding. AVOID HER AT ALL COSTS
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Almost every class has an in-class assignment but they were pretty easy. We were allowed to leave after we were done. The Big Book project caused some people a lot of stress but she was very accommodating and willing to help you with it. She is such a sweet woman and loves what she teaches!
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Caring

reviews.comment: She was a journalist so she is very passionate about the topic. She takes attendance with a mini quiz at the beginning of each class. The tests are open book and taken online in the classroom. Tests are half textbook and half lecture discussion. She removes your lowest test grade. Easy A if you read the test book (which is easy reading) and show up
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Rubin is a great professor! She does a great job of making lectures interesting, personable and interactive. She is an understanding and very approachable professor, who is clearly very passionate about journalism. Exams are open note but you should definitely still look over the material. Overall coursework is easy! Group project ends the semester
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: All tests are open book/notes but that doesn't mean don't worry about them. Go to class and actually pay attention (pretty interesting lectures anyways!) and write down all your notes in a word doc so it's easier to search for things during the tests. The chapters are pretty long but you can get by without reading them (I did). Drops lowest grade!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: My absolute favorite prof. Lots of textbook reading & movies for homework, nothing difficult though. Without readings/movies tests are difficult. One final group project that's fairly interesting. Drops lowest test grade (if she believes you deserve it). Fun discussions and interesting topics.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Loved this class so much. We spend a significant amount of time talking about current events/politics which was pretty cool. All her tests are open book/open note, but since you only have a certain amount of time to complete your exams, you should still know the content. Taking notes during lecture helps & having the online version of the book too.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I loved this class!! Although it was not an easy A, the class was timely and relevant which made me feel like what I was learning was important! Professor Rubin is extremely understanding and fair. I would love to take her again in the future!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: If you are ever having difficulty with her go to her office hours, she is willing to work and take constructive criticism and she brings her dog to her office. The readings and movies are interesting although she gets off topic in the lectures easily. Can be a tough grader but is willing to work with you if you show you care
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: The class was interesting at the beginning but then it got boring. You have to watch a lot of movies outside of class and read boring chapters. If you are not a journalism major do not take this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: First off, this class is a complete waste of time. If you are a COMM major do not even think of taking this class, if you are any major just don't take it. All the test are online and we had problems with technology regarding the test like 3 out of 5 test. You have to read three or four chapter per test and each chapter is like 39 pages, no joke.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Tests? Not many--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: This professor was one of my favorite of the year. She was caring, understanding, and was easily accessible. The materials that we use for sure will be on the tests. She drops your lowest test grade so it is not too much work. Just do the readings, watch the movies and you will be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Tests? Not many--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof Rubin is a very nice lady. She has assigned textbook reading and videos for each test. It seems like a lot but you can use your textbook, notes, and powerpoints on the test. The test are fair, as long as you have read you know where to find them. Overall this class was very interesting.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Not an easy A but not impossible either. Tests were tricky but even she realized that at the end and made them easier. Just put in the time by reading the chapters carefully and taking notes on that and the movies. If you enjoy modern culture topics you will like this class. Responds quick to emails and is available outside of class for questions
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I took this class hoping to learn about journalism, but it basically turned into a rundown on what was happening in politics each day. There are videos assigned on top of lectures for each test, and exams were very detailed. I was disappointed with the content and with the way she handled the conflict within my group for our final group project.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Professor Rubin is one of the best professors at A&M. You can tell from her lectures that she is very knowledgeable about the topics. Class involve a lot of discussion. Tests are open book open note, but you have to be familiar with the material to do well. Dont have your phone out in class. She also brings her dog to office hours.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This class will not be an easy A, but you will be a better writer. I have never worked so hard to get an A in a writing class, but by the end of the semester I was much better at writing. She also took us off campus to write real stories. She is so kindhearted. I loved chatting with her outside of class and will always remember the impact she had.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: The class seems easy at first but tests are very difficult and specific. You are allowed to miss 3 classes but on the 4th absence you are knocked down a whole letter grade. She is a tough grader and a 90 will earn you a B and an 80 will be a C. Very very difficult to do well. Beware!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.
